0022600206.text: The Grizzlies (6-2, 4-0 on the road) are third in the Southwest, 0.5 games back, and fifth in the West, and they come in on a two-game losing streak. The Raptors (4-4, 2-3 on the road) are fourth in the Atlantic, 3 games back, and seventh in the East, and they enter on a one-game skid. Memphis will be without Isaiah Stewart (knee bruise) and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness), while Toronto is missing Immanuel Quickley (hamstring), Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation), Nate Bittle (foot fracture), and Scottie Barnes (groin soreness). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Memphis lost both games in the 2025-26 season, most recently 128-96 in Memphis on April 3, 2026.
